newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-PADRES EXTEND MANAGER BRUCE BOCHY THROUGH 1999.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-PADRES EXTEND MANAGER BRUCE BOCHY THROUGH 1999.

text.p: The San Diego Padres Tuesday rewarded manager Bruce Bochy for guiding the team to its first division title since 1984 last season with a two-year contract extension.
Terms were not disclosed, but the deal includes a club option for the 2000 season.

The 41-year-old Bochy earned National League Manager of the Year honours after leading the Padres to a 91-71 record and the Western Division title. He was the first San Diego manager to win the award.

"I'm honoured that the Padres have shown this kind of confidence in me and I'm excited to be here for the next three years," said Bochy, whose team was swept by the St Louis Cardinals in the divisional playoffs.
Bochy ranks sixth among San Diego managers with 161 wins and second with a .526 winning percentage.

"This is certainly a well-deserved extension and we are all excited to have Bruce as the manager of the club for years to come," said team president Larry Lucchino. "A step such as this continues to add valuable stability to the organisation."
